account_id.description: The account it writes off to; left out, the reason's. Required for bad_debt and migrated (WRITEOFF-06).

amount.description: What is written off, in the invoice's currency: at most what is open of it (WRITEOFF-04); all of it clears the invoice.

date.description: The day it is written off; the month it posts in.

invoice_id.description: The invoice it writes off: an issued invoice with something open.

note.description: Why it is written off, in plain words: the approver reads it, and the audit trail keeps it.
examples: The customer went into liquidation; the liquidator's notice is attached to the invoice

reason.description: Why: discount, an agreed discount, to 4095 Discounts & refunds given unless another account is named; charges, bank or provider charges, and cross_currency, an unexplained cross-currency difference with the bank's advice, to 7030 FX & rounding unless named; bad_debt and migrated name their account (provisional until the chart-of-accounts review). A bad debt is tagged for the GST bad-debt relief review (FR-AR-11, P2).
